atlas-bifold-wallet.name: Atlas Bifold Wallet
atlas-bifold-wallet.short: Our signature bifold — eight card slots, two note compartments.
atlas-bifold-wallet.description: Cut from a single panel of full-grain hide tanned in Taroudant, the Atlas bifold is saddle-stitched by hand with waxed linen thread. Edges are bevelled, sanded and burnished four times so they stay sealed for years. The leather starts firm and darkens into a deep, personal patina after a few months in the pocket.

medina-slim-card-holder.name: Medina Slim Card Holder
medina-slim-card-holder.short: Four slots and a centre pull-tab. Slimmer than your phone.
medina-slim-card-holder.description: Three external card slots plus a centre pocket for folded notes. Skived down to a whisper at the edges so it disappears in a front pocket, yet strong enough to keep its shape after years of daily use.

voyager-passport-holder.name: Voyager Passport Holder
voyager-passport-holder.short: Passport, two cards and a boarding pass — nothing more.
voyager-passport-holder.description: A travel cover embossed with a compass rose, lined in soft suede so your passport never scuffs. Sized for all standard passports with a slot for a spare card and folded documents.

sahara-money-clip.name: Sahara Money Clip Wallet
sahara-money-clip.short: Brushed stainless clip, riveted through reinforced leather.
sahara-money-clip.description: For those who carry light. A solid brushed-steel clip holds notes flat against the body while four rear slots keep your essential cards to hand. Riveted, not glued.

riad-key-holder.name: Riad Key Holder
riad-key-holder.short: Keeps up to six keys silent and out of the way.
riad-key-holder.description: Solid brass hardware and a snap closure wrap your keys into a quiet bundle. No jangling, no torn pocket linings. The brass develops a warm patina alongside the leather.

custom-engraved-belt.name: Custom Engraved Belt & Tag Set
custom-engraved-belt.short: Your initials, hand-embossed. Cut to your exact size.
custom-engraved-belt.description: A bridle-leather belt with a solid brass buckle and a matching luggage tag, both hand-embossed with up to three initials. Cut and finished to your measurement, so it sits right from the first day.

fes-long-wallet.name: Fès Long Wallet
fes-long-wallet.short: Twelve slots, a zip coin pouch and room for full-size notes.
fes-long-wallet.description: Built for those who carry everything. Twelve card slots, a zipped coin pouch and a full-length note section, all saddle-stitched and edge-burnished by the same hands from start to finish.

nomad-card-sleeve.name: Nomad Card Sleeve
nomad-card-sleeve.short: One pocket. Three cards. The lightest thing we make.
nomad-card-sleeve.description: A single-pocket sleeve, hand-stitched on two edges and left open at the top. It moulds to your cards in a week and never loses grip.

faqs.a: Orders leave our Taroudant workshop within 24–48 hours. Delivery takes 24–48 hours in Casablanca, Rabat and Taroudant, and 2–4 working days everywhere else in Morocco.

faqs.q: Do you deliver all over Morocco?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver to all 12 regions, including rural communes, through our courier partners. Free delivery on every order above 500 MAD.

faqs.q: Can I pay cash on delivery?
faqs.a: Cash on Delivery is our only payment method. You pay the courier in cash when the parcel reaches your hands — nothing upfront, no card details.
You have 14 days from delivery to exchange any unused piece in its original box. Custom-engraved items are excluded because they are made to your initials.
Every piece is full-grain leather, vegetable-tanned in Morocco. No bonded leather, no PU coating. Each item ships with a certificate of origin from the tannery.

faqs.q: How do I care for my leather piece?
faqs.a: Wipe with a soft, dry cloth after use and keep it away from prolonged sun and moisture. Apply a neutral leather balm every few months to nourish the hide and let its natural patina deepen.

faqs.q: Can I order a custom piece?
faqs.a: Yes. Send us your initials, measurements and colour preference on WhatsApp and our workshop will confirm the design and price before we start cutting.
The fastest way is WhatsApp — tap the order or ask button on any page. Our team replies within the same day, every day of the week.

testimonials.name: Youssef B.
testimonials.text: I've carried the Atlas bifold for eight months. The colour has deepened beautifully and not one stitch has moved. Worth every dirham.

testimonials.name: Amine T.
testimonials.text: Ordered by WhatsApp on a Tuesday, paid the courier cash on Thursday morning. The packaging alone made it feel like a gift to myself.

testimonials.name: Sara El M.
testimonials.text: I bought the engraved belt set for my husband's birthday. The initials were perfect and the leather smells incredible.

testimonials.name: Khadija R.
testimonials.text: The Fès long wallet is exactly what I needed for work — sturdy, elegant and it only gets better with time. Fast delivery too.
